summary: Mara introduced herself. Left corporate law 4 months ago to do ceramics full time. Father stopped speaking to her properly after she quit — functional texts only ('OK', 'stay warm'). Business is slow, 2 months in. Mentioned the Cascadia Craft Fellowship grant but hadn't applied yet. Studio obsessively clean — her tell for anxiety. Underlying tension: did she make the right call leaving law?

First real paying client: restaurant commissioned twelve custom place settings. Father visited the studio — looked around ten minutes, said almost nothing, left. 'The most expensive silence I've ever heard.' Submitted the Cascadia grant application.

Got the Cascadia Craft Fellowship grant. Father called — said a gifted piece was beautiful. Large platters came out well. The law-career anxiety from session 1 is resolving — the question of whether she made the right call is answering itself. Session is ongoing.
